newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks close up but Dow losses depress.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks close up but Dow losses depress.

text.p: Madrid stock indices closed up on Tuesday but off session highs as Wall Street losses depressed late trading.
The general index closed 2.18 points, 0.49 pct, higher at 447.57. The Ibex-35 index of leading shares advanced 20.42 points, 0.4 percent, to 5,161.56.
"The market is at dangerous highs and today we have seen selling in some stocks. In the short term, this could extend across the board," said one trader.
Traders said trading had been very active with over 100 billion pesetas traded.
Telefonica gave indices a significant boost, rising 115 pesetas, 3.76 percent, to 3,170. Repsol also lent support, advancing 140 pesetas to 5,200.

In the banking sector, Banesto extended recent gains, rising 14.8 percent to 1,240, although traders were at odds over the exact reason for the rise. Some cited Banco Santander's desire to extend its 53 percent stake in the bank, others said expectations for healthy 1996 profits were boosting shares.
In the electricity sector, however, most stocks slipped lower. Sevillana and Fecsa lost more than four percent, while Endesa fell 70 pesetas to 9,070.
